feedback:
Written before this candidate has raced, so no outcome is claimed for it. The best raced design is iteration 6 (909.8): kp 2.25, kd 1.2, ki 0, base 1.2, 16 mm sensors at x = ±0.03 m. The oval and s-bend finish 20/20 there. The slalom finishes 16/20 with 4 off-track ends, 0.2 line-loss events per run, and steering oscillation of 0.26, so the remaining gap is on the slalom. The kd trend has been positive: raising kd from 0.9 (iteration 3, 893.6, slalom 15/20) to 1.2 (iteration 6, 909.8, slalom 16/20) helped without raising oscillation. Changing kp in either direction has been worse. Lowering kp to 2.0 at kd 1.2 (iteration 7, 856.1) cut slalom finishes to 11/20 and raised line-loss events to 0.6. Raising kp to 3.0 with a wider spread (iteration 5, 887.7) cut slalom finishes to 14/20 and raised control effort to 8.0. So kp 2.25 is near a local optimum, and kd is the lever still showing gain.

The candidate is a clean single-variable change from iteration 6: kd 1.2 to 1.5, with kp, base speed, ki, and geometry unchanged. It is valid against the contract and is the logical next step on the kd trend. Approve it now. A revision round would cost two runs for a change the evidence does not yet discriminate, and the race telemetry is more informative than another review.

Read the next race this way. If the slalom finishes at 17/20 or more with steering_oscillation at or below about 0.3 and control_effort not jumping, keep kd 1.5 as the new reference. If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or control_effort jumps on any track, kd has passed its useful limit. Return kd to 1.2 and test ki 0.1 with kd 1.2, since the integral term is the next untested knob. If slalom line_loss_events stay near 0.2 while off-track ends persist, the loss comes from the sensor footprint, not from damping. Then test 12 mm sensors (sensor_size 0.012) at the iteration 6 spread.
requested_changes: If steering_oscillation rises above 0.35 or control_effort jumps on any track at kd 1.5: set controller.kd back to 1.2 and try controller.ki 0.1, since iteration 6 at kd 1.2 gave oscillation 0.20 to 0.26 and the integral term is still untested.

If slalom off-track ends persist with line_loss_events at about 0.2 and oscillation low: change geometry.sensor_size from 0.016 to 0.012 at the iteration 6 spread, since iteration 5's wider spread did not reduce line loss (0.3 per run) and the 16 mm footprint may be the limit.

If the slalom finishes 17/20 or more with completion_time under 2.8 s: keep kd 1.5 and raise controller.base_speed from 1.2 to 1.25 in one step to recover time, since iteration 6 slalom finish times were about 2.50 s and the oval and s-bend have margin.
